#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    int n;
    string str;
    cin >> n;
    cin.ignore();
    getline(cin, str);
    str += '_';
    
    bool inPar = false;
    bool inWord = false;
    int wordsInside = 0;
    int wordLen = 0;
    int maxOutside = 0;
    
    for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
        char c = str[i];
        if (c == '_' || c == '(' || c == ')') {
            if (inWord) {
                inWord = false;
                if (inPar) {
                    wordsInside++;
                } else if (wordLen > maxOutside) {
                    maxOutside = wordLen;
                }
                wordLen = 0;
            }
            if (c == '(') {
                inPar = true;
            } else if (c == ')') {
                inPar = false;
            }
        } else {
            inWord = true;
            wordLen++;
        }
    }
    
    cout << maxOutside << " " << wordsInside << endl;
    return 0;
}
